title: A producer clicks a clip and is told which one it is

steps.caption: A new project opens with the starter clip on BD and nothing selected
Click the clip: it is outlined and announced as a clip
Click mid bar 3: the clip is deselected and a point set at 3.1.1
Drag over empty space touching no clip: nothing is selected
Reopened: the clip is where it was, and nothing is selected
Clicking the clip selects and announces it just as before
